11.Desc: Skreg's Iron-jaw steed cannot be knocked backward. When this skill is used, Skreg rides his Iron-jaw, which consumes energy every second up until all of his energy is exhausted. While Skreg is riding his Iron-jaw he is immune to control effects and his Attack Rating is increased. Skreg's Normal Attacks will also deal damage twice and knock down enemy targets.

20.Desc: The Iron-jaw assists Skreg in attacking his enemies by smashing them into the air, dealing a small amount of damage to them. If the enemy is successfully knocked into the air, Skreg will initiate an additional three-stage attack against them. While in a mounted position, Skreg beats his drum and rides his Iron-jaw into nearby enemies, dealing damage multiple times to them, also causing them to be knocked back.

31.Desc: Enemies deal less damage to Skreg the closer they get to him. Damage reduction is at its maximum when enemies are within Skreg's striking range.

41.Desc: An Iron-jaw appears periodically and charges towards the enemy closest to Skreg's allies' side of the battlefield, knocking back and stunning them and any enemies in its path, dealing damage to them in the process.

11.Desc: Lucius blesses all of his allies with a shield that mitigates damage, and allows them to recover health while it exists.

20.Desc: Lucius smashes the ground with his war hammer, which deals damage and knocks down nearby enemies. Each time an enemy is knocked down grants Lucius Damage Reduction for a period of time.

31.Desc: Lucius heals his most injured allied and also increases their Defense Rating. The amount of health healed is increased based on how injured the ally is.

41.Desc: Lucius creates a blessed shield that is able to reduce the damage he receives for a period of time and receives more Energy when he is attacked. Lucius will immediately halt his blessed shield if his ultimate skill is available for use. Lucius cannot be controlled by enemies while using this skill.

11.Desc: Rigby hurls his barrel towards an enemy target which deals damage on impact. Rigby then throws his pipe into the leaked contents of the barrel, causing it to explode and deal AoE damage to nearby enemies. Enemies close to the explosion are set alight and suffer damage over time.

20.Desc: Rigby takes a large swig of his drink and spits it back out at nearby enemies, dealing damage to them, also causing their Accuracy to be reduced for a period of time.

31.Desc: Rigby drinks himself into a drunken frenzy which reduces all the damage he receives and also increases his Haste. The effects of "Drunken Frenzy" can be stacked up to 3 times, with the third time causing Rigby to become even more enraged, further increasing his Haste while the effect is active, after which he returns to his normal state.

41.Desc: After the effects of "Drunken Frenzy" have worn off, Rigby will recover a portion of his max health every second for a period of time.

11.Desc: Torne deals damage to all enemies and causes bone spikes to protrude from the battlefield for a period of time. Bone spikes are able to deal damage periodically. If an enemy moves positions after a period of time they will subsequently lose health. Torne regrows his bone whip after using this skill.

20.Desc: Torne traps an enemy within a prison of bones and then proceeds to smash into the enemy target, dealing damage to them, also causing them to be knocked backward. After being knocked backward, the enemy loses Haste for a period of time.

31.Desc: Torne deals AoE damage multiple times to enemies that are standing before him, with the final attack leeching a certain percentage of all struck enemies' max health. All enemies that were struck by this attack are unable to recover life for the following period of time. Torne bone whip breaks after using this skill.

41.Desc: Torne absorbs the remains of any dead heroes on the battlefield and forms a bone whip out of their bones. Simultaneously, Torne recovers health and increases the value of his max health by the same amount. The range of Torne's normal attacks and skills is permanently increased after this skill is used for the first time.

11.Desc: Ezizh deals damage to enemies, with himself at the center of the attack, which ignites the ground for a period of time. Enemies upon the burning ground receive continuous damage and have their Attack Ratings reduced.

20.Desc: Ezizh mind controls the enemy farthest away from himself, causing them to walk towards him, also rendering the enemy unable to attack. Once in front of Ezizh, the enemy is dealt damage, knocked into their air and has their Attack Rating reduced.

31.Desc: Ezizh releases a wave of terror that deals damage to all enemies and also renders them unable to use their ultimate skills for a period of time. Each time an ally uses their ultimate skill, enemies are unable to use their ultimate skills.

41.Desc: While alive, Ezizh enrages his allies, allowing them to periodically regain Energy points.

11.Desc: Mehira charms all enemy heroes in front of her, causing them to start attacking each with other with Normal Attacks for a period of time. Enemies are unable to recover any Energy from attacking when in a charmed state.

20.Desc: Mehira uses her whip to deal AoE damage to everyone in front of her including allies. If this skill inflicts damage upon any of her allies, they will recover Energy, and their Haste will be increased for a period of time. A proportion of this skill's damage is converted into Mehira's health.

31.Desc: Deals damage to a single enemy target and reduces the damage Mehira may receive from the enemy target for a period of time. Simultaneously, Mehira will leech the enemy's health every second to restore her own.

41.Desc: At the beginning of battles Mehira will sacrifice health to summon minions which will automatically deal damage to her enemies continuously. After returning from an attack the minions will convert a proportion of the damage they have inflicted upon their enemies back to Mehira as health. If Mehira receives any fatal damage she will sacrifice a minion in order to restore a portion of her maximum health.

11.Desc: Brutus hacks at his enemies twice before spinning into a frenzy, dealing damage to them and converting the damage back into health. Brutus is immune to control effects while spinning.

20.Desc: Brutus lets out a terrifying roar that causes enemies to become more vulnerable. Physical damage received by enemies is increased and cannot be dodged.

31.Desc: When Brutus' health is relatively low, his Attack Rating and Attack Speed are increased.

41.Desc: When Brutus is dealt a fatal blow he is able to retain 1 health point and is immune to all subsequent damage for a period of time. skill can only be used once.

11.Desc: Souls of the dead spiral around Shemira causing continuous damage to nearby enemies for a period of time. While this skill is in effect, the damage it causes is converted into Shemira's health and when the skill finishes, a proportion of the total damage caused by it will be converted into Shemira's health

20.Desc: Shemira continuously leeches an enemy's life to restore her own which deals damage every 0.5 seconds. Power gradually increases while the effect is active.

31.Desc: Shemira deals damage to a magic based enemy and simultaneously prevents them from using any skills for several seconds. Effect lasts longer the more health Shemira has.

41.Desc: The higher Shemira's health is grants her additional Crit Rating and Attack Rating attributes.

11.Desc: The first time Lucretia uses her Ultimate skill, she absorbs her two revolving skulls, absorbing their energy until the end of battle. After absorbing the skulls, Lucretia's Life Leech is increased, as well as her Energy Recovery rate. Afterward, each time Lucretia uses her Ultimate skill, it deals AoE damage to nearby enemies.

20.Desc: Flames encircle Lucretia that deal damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies in close proximity to her. Enemies affected by Lucretia's flames have their Defense Ratings decreased for a period of time. This skill can be stacked. Damage dealt to Lucretia is reduced while the flames are present.

31.Desc: Lucretia marks the enemy with the highest Attack Rating and hunts them until their death. While Lucretia is hunting down the enemy target, the target's damage is increased. If the enemy formation includes Zaphrael, Lucretia shall prioritize her attacks against Zaphrael above all other enemies. Damage dealt to Lucretia while she is hunting is reduced for a period of time.

41.Desc: When positioned on the frontline, the Skull of Treachery is activated, raising Lucretia's Dodge and Tenacity. When positioned on the backline, the Skull of Destruction is activated, raising Lucretia's Attack Speed and her Crit Damage Amplification. The effects of both skills are simultaneously activated after Lucretia uses her Ultimate skill for the first time.

11.Desc: At the start of battles Morael creates a Star Core which remains on the battlefield, during which time she is immune to control effects. When Morael uses her Ultimate skill, a Cosmic Field is generated for a period of time. After the Cosmic Field has been generated, the Star Core unleashes a chain reaction that traps enemies in the Cosmic Field up until the field disappears or the enemy escapes from it. While the Cosmic Field exists, Morael deals damage every second to all enemies trapped by it. If an enemy escapes from the Cosmic Field, Morael will deal damage to them and stun them.

20.Desc: Morael commands her Star Core to move to the most densely concentrated area of enemies to deal damage to any enemies that are in its way.

31.Desc: Morael charges her Star Core with cosmic power, causing it to explode and deal damage to nearby enemies.

41.Desc: During battle, the Star Core gathers cosmic energy over time from the galaxy. Once the Star Core has finished gathering energy, it respectively transfers Energy points to Morael and all allies close to it, also granting them shields. Soon after, all of the Star Core's energy is depleted. The Star Core is able to gather a certain proportion of its total energy capacity per second.

11.Desc: Anoki blows his war horn, calling forth a stampede of Iron-jaw beasts that are able to strike up to 3 enemies nearest to the allied side. Enemies standing in the Iron-jaws' way are dealt damage and knocked back towards the edge of the screen. Once the Iron-jaws reach the edge of the screen, they will send nearby enemies flying, stunning and dealing damage to them.

20.Desc: Anoki stomps the ground, with the first two stomps each dealing damage to the enemy, and the final stomp stunning and dealing damage to them.

31.Desc: Anoki manifests an aura around himself which increases the Attack Rating of all allies including his own, reduces their damage received, and increases the frequency of their Normal Attacks.

41.Desc: Used once at the start of battles, this skill grants allies a protective shield that lasts for 7 seconds. It is used again for every subsequent 15 seconds, up to an additional 3 times.

11.Desc: Peggy calls forth two guards that each possess 120% of her own attributes. If an enemy is beside Peggy, her guards will return to protect her. Using the skill increases the guards' Haste and Defense Rating within a given time.

20.Desc: Peggy uses a magic scroll that increases her guards' Attack Rating within a given time.

31.Desc: Peggy's guard creates a shield around himself and the nearest non-summoned ally that exists for 9 seconds.

41.Desc: Peggy calls forth marksmen that fire a salvo at the enemy closest to Peggy, dealing damage to the target and reducing the target's Accuracy and Haste. The marksmen's shots will not miss.

11.Desc: Walker uses his shotgun to fire a shell at the enemy directly opposite himself, dealing damage to the enemy while firing 4 additional pellets that deal damage to nearby enemies. Pellets cannot inflict Critical Strikes. When using the skill, Walker cancels reloading and only uses Normal Attacks which are strengthened for a given time. When a shotgun shell strikes an enemy target, it deals additional AoE damage to nearby enemies, and the pellet quantity is increased to 6.

20.Desc: Walker smacks the enemy standing before him with his shotgun, stunning and dealing damage to them, and knocking them down. Once the enemy is knocked down, Walker uses a powerful shot to deal additional damage to them.

31.Desc: Walker pulls out his revolver and shoots 3 enemy targets with the lowest health. The Crit Rating of this skill increases as the target's health decreases.

41.Desc: Every time Walker's attacks deal a Critical Strike, his Crit Damage Amplification is additionally increased, to a maximum of 60 points.

11.Desc: Alaro attacks and deals damage to an enemy target with poison daggers.

20.Desc: Passive. Alaro receives less damage while on the enemy side of the battlefield.

31.Desc: Alaro creates a Dummy Double that occupies his original position at the start of battles. The dummy is immune to health loss effects and can withstand up to 120 attacks. After creating the dummy, Alaro goes incognito, during which time he is immune to damage and control effects. When Alaro's dummy is destroyed, Alaro ceases being incognito and stuns and deals damage to enemies within a given range around the dummy.

41.Desc: Alaro deals damage to the enemy with the highest Attack Rating while removing most of the enemy's buffs.

11.Desc: Isabella casts a spell that launches up to 8 arcane orbs. Each orb damages a random enemy hero, prioritizing enemies that have not already been hit by the current spell. Otherwise, the enemy with the lowest health will be prioritized.

20.Desc: Isabella casts a spell as her Normal Attacks. After a short delay the enemy with the lowest health is targeted with lightning and suffers damage.

31.Desc: Isabella casts a continuous spell, stealing Energy every second from the nearest enemy hero.

11.Desc: Safiya focuses her energy into a massive orb that deals AoE damage on impact. The longer she focuses, the higher the damage and the wider the AoE.

20.Desc: Safiya fire a magic orb at a single enemy target, damaging them and stunning them briefly. The orb then splits into 2 weaker orbs that strike other nearby enemies.

31.Desc: Safiya grants herself a temporary aura that deals continuous damage to nearby enemies.

41.Desc: Any damage Safiya receives from enemies within her shield increases her Attack Rating.

11.Desc: Rigby hurls his barrel towards an enemy target, dealing damage on impact. Rigby then throws his pipe into the leaked contents of the barrel, causing it to explode and deal AoE damage to nearby enemies. Enemies close to the explosion are set alight and suffer continuous damage for a period of time.

20.Desc: Rigby takes a large swig of his drink and spits it back out at enemies in front of him, damaging them and reducing their Accuracy for a period of time.

31.Desc: Rigby gains 3 stacks of the Drunken Frenzy effect and enters Rage mode. This skill is automatically used at the start of battle.

41.Desc: After being hit with 40 critical strikes, Rigby exits Rage mode and uses Drunken Frenzy again within the next 10 seconds. When not in Rage mode, Rigby takes significantly more damage from critical strikes.

11.Desc: At the start of battle, Ulmus immediately roots himself to the ground until the end of the battle. After rooting himself, his Normal Attack becomes a ranged attack with a wider AoE.

20.Desc: Ulmus uses his roots to entangle the enemy who has dealt the greatest total damage, damaging them. Entangled enemies cannot attack or use skills while entangled.

31.Desc: Ulmus blesses himself with the Forest's Oath, reducing the damage he receives for a period of time.

41.Desc: After rooting himself to the ground, Ulmus begins to grow over time. Each time he grows, the retaliatory damage dealt by Thorned Remedy is increased.
